prompt: A line passes through the points $(2, 7)$ and $(6, 19)$. What is the slope of the line?
hint: Slope is rise over run: the change in $y$ divided by the change in $x$.

hints.text: Slope is rise over run: the change in $y$ divided by the change in $x$.
The $y$ values change by $19 - 7 = 12$; the $x$ values change by $6 - 2 = 4$.

learningObjective: Compute the slope of a line through two given points.
explanation: The order of the points does not matter as long as it is consistent: $\dfrac{7 - 19}{2 - 6} = \dfrac{-12}{-4} = 3$ too.

alternativeExplanations.title: Where the sign errors come from
steps: The one dangerous mistake is subtracting the $y$ values in one order and the $x$ values in the other.
$\dfrac{19 - 7}{2 - 6} = \dfrac{12}{-4} = -3$ — right magnitude, wrong sign, and it will be one of the answer choices.
Write both differences top-to-bottom in the same order every time and this error disappears.
